description: The file defines API routes for authentication and user management in a FastAPI application, including registration, login, current user info, role listing and assignment, and role creation (as a no-op). It makes use of SQLAlchemy for database interactions and security functions for password hashing and token creation.

methods.name: UserOut _user_to_out(user: User)
methods.description: Converts a User object to a UserOut schema, including roles.

methods.name: UserOut register(payload: RegisterRequest, session: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db_session))
methods.description: Endpoint to register a new user with optional default role 'customer'.

methods.name: TokenResponse login(payload: LoginRequest, session: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db_session))
methods.description: Endpoint for user login that returns a JWT token upon successful credential validation.

methods.name: UserOut me(current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Returns information about the currently authenticated user.

methods.name: list[RoleOut] list_roles(_: User = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Lists all available roles, represented as enum values.

methods.name: RoleOut create_role( payload: RoleOut, _: User = Depends(require_roles(["admin"])), )
methods.description: No-op method to satisfy schema, roles are fixed as an enum.

methods.name: UserOut attach_role( user_id: str, payload: AttachRoleRequest, _: User = Depends(require_roles(["admin"])), session: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db_session), )
methods.description: Assigns a specified role to a user given by user_id, for admins.

ctags.name: attach_role
ctags.signature: ( user_id: str, payload: AttachRoleRequest, _: User = Depends(require_roles(["admin"])), session: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db_session), )

ctags.name: login
ctags.pattern: /^async def login(payload: LoginRequest, session: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db_session)) -> Token/

ctags.name: register
ctags.pattern: /^async def register(payload: RegisterRequest, session: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db_session)) ->/
